# QB rushing width tuning: tune seasons only

*Generated by `backtest.py --tune-width --tune-grid qb --tune 2022,2023`. Do not edit by hand. The test seasons were not read.*

The starting QB's own settings, every other width setting held at the shipped values (`{"catch_conc": null, "eff_sd_qb": 0.15, "eff_sd_rec": 0.0, "eff_sd_rush": 0.3, "share_conc_carries": 20.0, "share_conc_qb": 80.0, "share_conc_targets": 40.0}`). Same rule as the main grid: QB-rushing CRPS first; among settings not measurably worse than the best, the width closest to 0.20. *Off* = no QB-only setting: the QB is one more component of the carries Dirichlet and shares eff_sd_rush (the sampler before props-v1.21).
